title: City of Spokane Reportedly Distributed Purported AI-Generated Clocktower Flyer Resembling Graphic Designer Matthew Clinard's Artwork

behaviors.text: A Spokane Parks and Recreation employee reportedly used a purported generative AI image tool to create a flyer promoting the restored Great Northern Clocktower chimes.
The flyer reportedly reproduced elements of artist a person's commercially sold Clocktower sticker and was distributed by the mayor's office without the city-required AI disclosure.
After Clinard complained publicly, the city removed the image and apologized, then began considering AI-policy and employee-training reforms.
